start.text: Hello? Reached the new place? … Veg-only aunty? Good, good. At least somebody will make you eat properly.

tired.text: You sound tired. Did you eat? … Don't lie, I can hear it in your voice.

monday.text: Appa is asking about Monday. Iron your clothes tonight itself, don't do it in the morning and go late.

sleep.text: Okay, okay, sleep now. Eat properly. Call tomorrow.

quiet.text: (The call ends. Somewhere down the lane a pressure cooker whistles. The fan turns. The pillow smells of somebody else's coconut oil.)
